title.narrative: Isiolo Food Security Project: Mitigating Impact of Economic downturn

description.narrative:
This project falls within the DFID funded Food Security Project which aims to mitigate the impact of economic downturn for poor and marginalised people in Kenya and Zimabwe through supporting interventions that increase agricultural production and access to food. Kenya has been selected because the economic downturn and recurrent droughts has resulted in increasing cost of agricultural inputs and food stuffs which has in turn exacerbated an already fragile food security situation. In Kenya, the project will be implemented by two of CAFOD’s partners, the Diocese of Isiolo and Diocese of Kitui.
In Isiolo, this additional funding will expand on and complement ongoing work under the East Africa Sustainable Livelihoods programme. This project will therefore support farmers in Isiolo Diocese through construction of water facilities and installation of irrigation pipelines as well as provision of drought tolerant seeds to farmers and capacity building for farmers on crop husbandry. Environmental conservation will be mainstreamed. It is hoped that this will increase agricultural productivity and availability of food during the drought period. Local communities will be mobilized to engage in these activities and will work in groups.
As the current programmes are funded directly by CAFOD, specific activities have been earmarked for these additional funds from DFID.
